items.headline: 49ers rule out Bosa for Monday, still hopeful for Evans, Juszczyk
items.description: The San Francisco 49ers will have to wait at least another week for the return of defensive end Nick Bosa, though there's at least a chance they'll have both receiver Mike Evans and fullback Kyle Juszczyk for Monday's game vs. the Washington Commanders.

items.headline: Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt out vs. 49ers with groin injury
items.description: Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt won't play against the 49ers because of a groin injury, coach Dan Quinn said.
